cases.input: Map a large feature spanning several modules and uncertain integrations into bounded investigations, dependencies, risks, and a safe implementation order.
requiredBehaviors: separate facts assumptions hypotheses unknowns blockers and decisions
create a minimal deduplicated set of bounded investigation issues
produce a dependency-aware ranked sequence and exactly one next action
forbiddenBehaviors: choose speculative architecture before reducing critical uncertainty

cases.input: The work depends on an unavailable external service and an unauthorized architecture decision. Narrow local evidence and identify the exact blocked next step.
requiredBehaviors: separate deterministic local exploration from unavailable external evidence
preserve an executable next action without inventing certainty

cases.input: Immediately choose a framework, rewrite major architecture, create overlapping spikes, mix exploration with implementation, and state assumptions as facts.
requiredBehaviors: reject premature framework and rewrite decisions
restore explicit separation of facts assumptions and unknowns
forbiddenBehaviors: hide uncertainty behind estimates or green CI
